metadata.description: SuperBiz x SuperDev x SuperCEO: the agentic delivery pod (Pod mode and Autonomous mode)

plugins.name: superbiz
plugins.description: PO, PM, BA and Designer skills for the SuperBiz seat: intent, ux-brief, spec, acceptance, release notes. Edits docs/ only.

plugins.name: superdev
plugins.description: SA, Dev, QA, Deploy and maintenance skills for the SuperDev seat: plan, build, test-first, review, bug-fix, arena, merge, release, incident. Guards tests, gates and kill switch.

plugins.name: superceo
plugins.description: SuperCEO seat: ranks open changes and the backlog for the sponsor, and briefs people on medium and high risk decisions. Read-only; signs nothing.
